title: rtp-ed137: Add support for RRC paired frequency mode
description:
The current RTP ED-137 dissector includes limited Radio Remote Control (RRC) support, namely for only the single frequency mode of RRC. This adds support for the other mode of RRC, paired frequency.

Attached packet capture rtp_ed137_rrc.pcap includes actions to exercise each RRC field. Attached rtp_ed137_rrc.pcap.readme.txt details the actions performed in the capture.

tools/fuzz-test.sh tools/rtp_ed137_rrc.pcap was run locally for 10,000 iterations (all passes).

[rtp_ed137_rrc.pcap](/uploads/e30dcc430c8fef372bd7a356c5d400ef/rtp_ed137_rrc.pcap)

[rtp_ed137_rrc.pcap.readme.txt](/uploads/d05e4b772640d016568fe9330c81a6e5/rtp_ed137_rrc.pcap.readme.txt)

The changes were originally structured as four commits to split review into smaller chunks, but were squashed into one in accordance with the developer's guide section 3.10.5.2 (Squashing Merge Requests). Can push the four commits instead, upon request.
